message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a man in a black suit and white shirt positioned inside a green metal trash can filled with black garbage bags. The man, seen from the waist up, has an expressive face and holds both hands up near his head. A reddish-brown leather shoe is suspended in mid-air above him, with its thin black laces floating. The trash can’s metal lid is angled upward, resting on the man's head. Around the base of the can are several scattered shoes: a black loafer, a red and white sneaker, a white sneaker, and a tan platform sandal. A crumpled red bag sits on the light-colored ground. The background is a plain off-white, with a red vertical border on the left.

The text at the top reads "ERICK THOHIR TENTANG PERSIAPAN ASIAN GAMES" and "DI BALIK PEMBACOKAN HERMANSYAH". The magazine title "TEMPO" is centered in large white letters. Red text on the left states "KALENG ROMBENG ANGKET KPK". Below it, smaller black text describes a plan involving the KPK, WhatsApp groups, and police. A barcode and publishing details for July 17-23, 2017, are at the bottom left.
